source.title: Sprint work-slice inventory: code-ready execution, explicit design holds, and gameplay QA queue (Nov 21)
source.body:
> **Owner-approved Progression enhancement — Nov 21, 2026:** [#474](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/474) is the **code-goal owner ledger** for optional MXP purchases of additional Astral Sorcery perk-point tokens, with idempotent native API grants, Progression-side restoration ledger and no new separate module. Adapter, transaction, persistence and source tests are independently ready slices subject to exact API/JAR verification and designated Progression writer; exact pricing remains configurable/balance review. Its **AS-A01** native perk-node census is queued for the next build as **offline Type A** independent of whether the purchase adapter ships. Nothing has been coded, tested or built by this entry.

> **H2 #237 promotion checkpoint — Nov 21, 2026:** [PR #464](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/464) is SOURCE READY for designated `dev/progression` writer's review. JEI / PX / Replication / Jade provider census and existing filters are documented in `compat/progression/design/TOOLTIP-PROVIDER-AUDIT-237-2026-11-21.md`; machine balances and JEI collector **recipe cost** are not per-item price leaks. **All eligible source CI SUCCESS at exact head `070f042e5ee33408dcb4fc08eceb86743454b0ac`**; loader/server smoke SKIPPED under QA authorization policy. B/C gameplay, exact third-party JAR parity and possible converter UI paths remain queued; no integration promotion or full smoke. Dragon-diet #444 still NOT READY TO CODE.

> **Jade code-ready slice completed at source level — Nov 21, 2026:** H2 [#237 / PR #464](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/464) adds optional ProjectE Jade block-EMC suppression with tagged-only native `JadeTooltipCollectedCallback`, Stone + native learned-only gate and local viewer binding, compile-only Jade 15.10.6. Static Gradle CI PASS at code head `55583a5`; B/C client QA still queued. **Dragon diet #444 remains NOT READY TO CODE** while the food engine is under owner redesign; PR #463 remains draft/held. 

> **Tooltip source checkpoint — November 21, 2026:** H2 #237 / [PR #464](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/464) now includes source-level ProjectE, Expansion and Replication item-tooltip filters (including native learned-only numeric gating) in addition to the persistent milestones. Full Java/static quick CI green; **Jade's separate ProjectE block EMC provider, exact binary parity and client QA remain outstanding**. The #444 **NOT READY TO CODE** owner hold below remains in force; do not revive Dragon diet work or PR #463 until the shared food engine is stable.

> **LIVE OWNER UPDATE — food work paused.** All Dragon-diet development in #444, including source-ready rows H/food, is **NOT READY TO CODE** while the owner changes the central food handling engine. Do not continue PR #463 or promote its candidate values/map until the new engine contract is reviewed; related food QA remains queued. This hold supersedes historical READY rows below. Continue approved nonfood implementation: per-player tooltip adapters in #237 / PR #464.

# Sprint code-readiness / design / gameplay QA inventory — 2026-11-21

**Authoritative live scope:** [sprint roadmap #391](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/391), [release scope #390](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/390), `main/AGENTS.md` and `test/full-integration/AGENTS.md`. This is the first **slice-level triage** required by the Nov 21 agent policy. **Maintain this issue** rather than copying a stale queue into new tickets. Link the *actual owning* PR/branch before work starts.

**Evidence boundary:** Snapshot of **65 open issues and 50 open PRs** returned by GitHub searches on Nov 21, cross-checked against S1/S2 requirements, named open PR descriptions, relevant issue contracts, active QA register and selected actual `test/full-integration` files. It is **not** a byte-for-byte audit of every PR file or proof of installed JARs. Do not infer a green CI run, a merge or source-ready from `mergeable: true`; do not infer in-game PASS. Revalidate live heads, 12-hour inactivity, collisions, source locks and designated writer at pickup.

**Legend:** `READY / NO OPEN IMPLEMENTATION PR FOUND` = approval seems sufficient for a scoped coding or Type-A implementation investigation, but ownership and current code must be checked at pickup; `STAGED / OWNED` = open PR or workstream already owns the change, so **do not start a parallel copy**; `DEPENDENCY BLOCKED` = implementation can resume after a named source/dependency; `DESIGN HOLD` = ask owner before that specific behavior; `QA QUEUED` = source or pin cannot count as client/gameplay PASS.

## 1. Current sprint S1 (Nov 20–22): source and integration pipeline

- [ ] **S1-A — publish an exact inclusion matrix.** Integration writer: reconcile `manifest/mods.json`, `index.toml`, `manifest/next-qa-target.json`, `manifest/integration-sources.json` and [live-test register](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/blob/test/full-integration/docs/qa/LIVE-TEST-INCLUSION-REGISTER.md), with per-mod selected/required/conditional/research/deferred state, exact pins/dependencies/donor SHA, and INCLUDED/BLOCKED/OWNER-DEFERRED. **STAGED/OWNED** by [#403](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/403) (scope draft), [#388](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/388) (six-mod register) and integration writer. Incorporate later owner exception [Creature Feature #419](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/419), [Aquamirae & Nouveau #404](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/404), [The Graveyard #386](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/386) and existing #387. **Do not equate an unindexed candidate `.pw.toml` with installed.** #390/#403 have historical status disagreements (notably Born in Chaos); verify the latest explicit owner decision rather than guessing.
- [ ] **S1-B — verify and promote approved external pins with source ownership.** **STAGED/OWNED:** [#399](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/399) four encounters + two libraries; [#398](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/398) HerbalBrews; [#425](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/425) owner-uploaded Aura Cascade (verify publisher bytes); [#392](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/392) Angels config. Integrator must check official exact JAR hashes, dependency closure, same-head manifests/index and read-only preflight. Arcane Archives needs its own exact pin/Modonomicon check under #387. **No independent hourly writer** on owned paths.
- [ ] **S1-C — Creature Feature 1.3.0 and dependencies.** [#419](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/419): **READY / NO OPEN IMPLEMENTATION PR FOUND** in this inventory. Official version is selected; Type A official JAR hash/metadata and Blueprint/other mandatory dependency closure, then stage isolated non-colliding pins. Integration writer owns final roster/index. Preserve all native spawns pending observed defect; taxonomy and gameplay QA separately queued.
- [ ] **S1-D — Aquamirae & Nouveau + Ars Conflux pins.** [#404](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/404) / [#406](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/406): owner-approved exact versions but no verified official hashes. **READY Type-A pin evidence; STAGED/OWNED documentation**, coordinate with #399/integration. Full-strength Depths config and Sea Dragon 1.5x attributes require actual pin/source checks; scoped PvP effect remains a separate design hold.
- [ ] **S1-E — Unified/Tyr Progression migration and stack.** **STAGED/OWNED** [cutover #376](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/376), [rename #424](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/424), [Core/Monk/Hunter pilot #379](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/379), [Bountiful specialist #382](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/382), [starter home #418](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/418), [night vision #427](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/427), [ReFoxed engine #393](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/393). **Executable unfinished work:** #382 still needs bridge registration/unit test; reconcile package/namespace changes and overlapping `NewbieMode`/runtime hooks before promotion; do not fork engine work. Owner: `dev/progression` writer, then integration writer. Type-A module/ABI quick checks only unless a separate build is approved.
- [ ] **S1-F — Trader's Vengeance rename / active combat.** **STAGED/OWNED** [#412](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/412) lava-golem culpability, [#426](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/426) namespace rename, surviving Trader module workstream; [#351](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/351) is historical/stacked, not a second authoring lane. Require current Java 21 module compile and dependency-preserving promotion; gameplay later.
- [ ] **S1-G — Bountiful basic pilot.** **STAGED/OWNED** [pool compiler #366](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/366), [Quest Shop/zero EMC #378](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/378), [Inn #381](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/381), [specialist bridge #382](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/382), [next-test intake #383](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/383). Runtime curated pools/rewards, authoritative settlement, transformation native predicates and end-to-end registration are **not** proved by ready pin. Integrate the 3-decree starter pilot first; separate additional school/form decrees and balance decisions.
- [ ] **S1-H — housing and kitchen.** **STAGED/OWNED** [18 houses #416](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/416), [Regular one-time ability #418](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/418), Inn #381; reconcile immutable NBT rebuilds, native stock-grant limitation, and disposable staging. [Kitchen #368](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/368) still lacks verified Occult Cooking pin and, if native route fails, a *real* Farmer's Delight skillet timing adapter. **DEPENDENCY BLOCKED on binary/API audit**, not a new cooking design.
- [ ] **S1-I — intake of configured content / capture.** **STAGED/OWNED:** [creature registry #353](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/353), [capture #373](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/373), [EvilCraft guard #413](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/413), [rare-material #339](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/339), [food/config #343](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/343), [ritual #338](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/338), [ink #336](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/336), [quest labels #345](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/345), [Theurgy KubeJS roster #325](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/325), [Angler's Hat #321](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/321). This is mostly **merge/reconcile/stale-base and QA evidence work**, not zero work. Avoid parallel tag, config, index, or source-lock changes.

## 2. Release-relevant fixes: implementation stage versus QA only

- [ ] **P0/P1 bag-within-bag prevention** [#16](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/16): cross-mod source guard **STAGED/OWNED** in [draft #401](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/401). Still requires exact mixin/handler validation, inventory automation coverage, preservation of old nested contents and gameplay checks. Do **not** duplicate its implementation.
- [ ] **Starter/UI fixes** [#309](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/309) / [#402](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/402) Curios icon; [#305](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/305) / [#393](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/393) + [#394](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/394) middle click; [#306](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/306) / [#396](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/396) populated Tome; [#310](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/310) / [#395](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/395) Ars 49-node compact layout (plus [#345](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/345) labels). **STAGED/OWNED:** reconcile overlapping `index.toml` / `pack.toml`, engine prerequisites and runtime regeneration. Every actual client UI check remains **QA QUEUED**, not source PASS.
- [ ] **QoL** [#384](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/384) / [#385](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/385): blaze rod fireproofing and stew stacking **source-staged**; Swing Through Grass exact hash/index integration **not complete**. Existing writer/integrator owns; test stew bowl return (including full inventory), attack reach and blaze rod lava drop.
- [ ] **Dragon diets** [#60](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/60): Sourceberry fix already exists on named donor; [#343](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/343) stages modded enchanted carrot; **A/technical ID audit still actionable** for sushi/effective data map and current staged ID, no duplicate selector. B/C food use/relog still pending. **Do not call all three fixed.**
- [ ] **Vampire dual blood/HUD** [#58](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/58): **TECHNICAL INVESTIGATION, P1**; reproduced on Nov 14 snapshot, no confirmed root cause. Compare exact *current* Transformations native init/sync with older report before a targeted adapter patch; no automatic double-wallet/refill. C test must prove immediate feeding and visible single bar without relog.
- [ ] **Monk purchase and spell mining** [#59](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/59): **TECHNICAL RECONCILIATION, P1**; historical Vampirism/Tyz architecture cannot be copied uncritically after #376. Re-check current Progression purchase authorization, first-rank noncombat/magic action credit and tree-feller anti-farm semantics; implement approved slice only through engine writer.
- [ ] **BetterX startup** [#304](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/304): **READY / NO OPEN IMPLEMENTATION PR FOUND for Type-A exact native preset/config investigation**, then minimal verified client defaults if missing. Suppress welcome without disabling Tectonic Overworld or BetterEnd End; configuration key is *candidate*, not verified on exact fork. C worldgen comparisons required.
- [ ] **ProjectE Energy Converters download** [#303](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/303): existing indexed file points at official CF ID; **external/diagnostic blocker**: obtain actual sanitized Prism/Packwiz error and test authorized provider bytes/redirects before changing pin. Do not invent a broken hash or unauthorized mirror.
- [ ] **World and HUD already source-correct:** [#308](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/308) FTB sidebar/minimap config **currently** contains `top_left` / `top_right`; historical Tyz button issue requires reassessment with #376 (not a fresh Tyz patch). [Comforts #34](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/34) `mods/comforts.pw.toml` and [JER #54](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/54) `mods/just-enough-resources-jer.pw.toml` are **already indexed** on integration, as are manifest `enabled_in_pack=true` rows. **QA QUEUED, NOT NEW PIN TASKS.** Re-verify live installed bytes before claiming client pass.

## 3. Candidate unclaimed executable slices for hourly Work (after live duplication/age check)

These are **candidate tasks, not automatic branch assignments**. Each is specific enough for source investigation or isolated implementation without choosing new mechanics. Select only if its **issue/owning workstream is inactive for >=12 hours**, no active writer/overlapping branch exists, and current source remains consistent. Existing workstream PRs take priority over new duplicate branches.

- [ ] **H1 — Mahou Catalyst Exchange native-scoped bridge** [#57](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/57) / [#37](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/37). Five approved Neo Vitae dust inputs; use native circle item scanner and mana accounting, **not** global entity tick. First slice: pinned v1.36.31 ABI/seam audit + narrowly scoped adapter and unit regression; C no-mana/partial-stack/load/pickup test later. **READY / NO OPEN IMPLEMENTATION PR FOUND in current list**, but reconcile historical #36 and current Mahou native source lock.
- [ ] **H2 — per-player ProjectE EMC tooltip milestone** [#237](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/237). First Stone acquisition (incl. trade), persistent server-owned/client-synced unlock, suppress only numeric/leaked per-item EMC/learned overlays while preserving native settings. Isolate ProjectE portion; **Replication first-unlock trigger and creative treatment are separate design questions**. **READY for Type-A pin/API check and first engine slice**, subject to Progression owner and #424 namespace reconciliation.
- [ ] **H3 — personal enchanting filtering shared API** [#328](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/328) before [Eidolon adapter #407](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/407). Owner approved six-book personal exclusion and 32-slot virtual candle packing/Arcana behavior; first source slices: exact pinned Improvable/Apothic skill data and server-owned filter snapshot/preview invalidation, then portable/placed consumers. **NO OPEN IMPLEMENTATION PR FOUND; owned subsystem is Progression**. Do not write standalone #407 until its shared API exists. Check exact latest decisions in #328.
- [ ] **H4 — Bountiful and/or housing targeted unit/registration follow-through**, **ONLY by existing writer**: [#382](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/382) missing registration and tests; [#366](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/pull/366) finish evidence/guarded compiler per its current branch. This is real code work **inside existing PRs**, not a new "nothing to do" report.
- [ ] **H5 — TMM Economy mapper and EMC Catalyst core** [#322](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/322): locked 20 Mana/EMC, 200 FE/EMC, 5 mB blood/EMC, placer-UUID personal debits; compile baseline and implement only **verified missing** native API mapper/accounting or safe pool filling. **SOURCE-RECONCILE FIRST** with earlier #350 and ongoing economy owner; *not* permission for a parallel implementation. Crafting recipe and Source Jar capacity remain design holds.
- [ ] **H6 — source audit of WorldWeaver default preset** [#304](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/304). Exact pinned fork/JAR client welcome key and default new-world preset, followed by narrowly scoped config change only if not already fixed. Independent of new full build; report Tectonic/BetterEnd acceptance as C queue.
- [ ] **H7 — targeted new-mod registry compatibility preparation** [#419](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/419) and [#386](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/386). Once exact JARs exist, add **noncolliding** creature taxonomy/capture/Hunter proposal rows for actual IDs. **DEPENDENCY on source audit and #353/#373 registry writer**; no guessing names or concurrently editing that writer's ledger.

## 4. Explicit owner/design blockers — do not block unrelated slices

[Optional paths #415](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/415) and [Eldrich Echoes #420](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/420) are tentative/research, not automatic implementation or alpha gates.

### Type-A next-build offline census (separate from B/C gameplay queue)

- [ ] **AS-A01 — actual Astral Sorcery perk-tree enumeration** — **QUEUED / NOT RUN** for next owner-authorized comprehensive QA candidate. Read the **exact installed JAR, source/registry and effective config**, enumerate distinct registered perk IDs and reachable/conditional nodes, identify roots and point costs, calculate native available points and any extra tokens needed for all simultaneously attainable perks. Record installed artifact SHA, method, per-kind counts, excluded/unreachable reasons and any runtime-only limitations; source inspection does not certify UI behavior. This A check **does not depend on the MXP-purchase adapter shipping**. Detailed acceptance and Progession code-ready slices: [#474](https://github.com/heatwaveqc/Too-Much-Magic-Modpack/issues/474). No assembly/boot/package authorization.

## 5. Persistent in-game testing queue — not evidence of PASS

**All B/C below are QUEUED until an exact owner-authorized candidate is actually available.** The issue/PR owner must copy/link detailed cases to the active QA ledger and report exact SHA/build, test mode, setup, expected vs observed, cleanup and PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL. Type A reads/CI are not gameplay. No exact commands asserted here without runtime verification.
